map.批量添加前缀后缀 使用指南: Batch Add Prefix and Suffix User Guide
map.为每行文本批量添加固定的前缀或后缀（如编号、符号），支持正则与分隔符，适合清单批: Adds a fixed prefix or suffix (such as an index or symbol) to every line in bulk, with regex and separator support. Suitable for batch list processing and format cleanup.
map.批量加引号/括号：给每行内容包上单引号或圆括号，快速拼 SQL IN 列表或数组: Batch quote or bracket: wrap each line in single quotes or parentheses to quickly assemble SQL IN lists or array literals.
map.生成 SQL/代码列表：把名字列表加『'』与逗号，直接贴进查询。: Generate SQL/code lists: add quotes and commas to a name list so it can be pasted straight into a query.
map.标注与包装：给每项加统一前缀（如「TODO:」）或后缀（如「.com」）。: Labeling and packaging: give each item a uniform prefix (such as "TODO:") or suffix (such as ".com").
map.：粘贴「a/b/c」每行一个，加前缀「'」后缀「',」得「'a',『b',『c': : paste "a/b/c" one per line, add prefix "'" and suffix "'," to get "'a','b','c',"; drop the trailing comma on the last item to get ('a','b','c') without typing it by hand.
map.尾逗号怎么处理？: How Is the Trailing Comma Handled?
map.可在选项去掉末行后缀，或用「末行不加」模式，避免 SQL 语法错误；也可生成后手: You can remove the suffix on the last line via the options, or use the "skip last line" mode to avoid SQL syntax errors; alternatively, delete the final comma manually.
map.内容含引号会冲突吗？: What If the Content Already Contains Quotes?
map.会。若原文本已有单引号，再包单引号会破坏字符串；此时改用双引号或转义，或选无冲突: Yes. If the source already has single quotes, wrapping again breaks the string; use double quotes or escaping instead, or pick a conflict-free separator.
